messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Production SLO breach detected for /v1/pageflow (p95/p99). p95=820ms (SLO 300ms), p99=2.3s (SLO 1s). Streaming stalls rate up to 4.7% over 5m. Increasing error-rate on some streaming routes. Auto-create incident ticket INC-2321.

marta (SRE): I'm on pager. pulling up dashboards (p95/p99, stream stall histogram).

cheng (oncall): I'm online. joining call in 2. Reviewing recent deploys. Any caller IDs?

ryan (eng-runtime): FYI I rolled a config change at 2026-03-14T10:12UTC that enabled the new prefix-hash path for cache keys (prefix-hash=v2). It rolled as a canary -> 100% last night.

ryan (eng-runtime): quick snapshot from deploy-bot:
```
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-14T10:12 by ryan - config: prefix-hash=v2, prefix-ttl=600, streaming-enabled=true, kv-namespace=pageflow_v2
```

sophie (ml-infra): Observed a sharp drop in prefix cache hit rate right after that deploy. region EU hit-rate 86% -> 11% within 3m. same for NA.

marta (SRE): That matches the latency spike window. p95 jump coincides with cache miss storm. Are misses causing backend paging? Any evidence of paging/prefix eviction churn?

ryan (eng-runtime): Logs show KV lookup miss ratio increased and KV backend returned more 'cold' loads triggering model streaming to read from spine more often. eviction_rate metric spiked 7x. Also noticed some TTLs evaluated as 0 for a subset of keys (possible config parsing bug for new key format).

cheng (oncall): Customer impact assessment: top-10 tenants account for ~42% of requests; several on the dashboard show increased timeouts and user-facing streaming stalls. Luis, any direct customer reports?

luis (PM): Support flagged 3 enterprise customers with degraded real-time features (chat streaming stalls). SLA p99 for those customers breached, they're on a support call. Need quick mitigation.

marta (SRE): Triage options (fast -> slower):
- revert prefix-hash rollout (fastest)
- temporarily increase cache TTL and reindex warmup job for top prefixes
- route traffic to legacy model variant (fallback)
- if revert blocked, enable aggressive prefetch for hot prefixes

ryan (eng-runtime): I'm starting a rollback to prefix-hash=v1 now. Command: 
```
# rollback to previous config
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/config-manager -- /bin/sh -c \"apply-config --service pageflow --set prefix-hash=v1 --outcome=canary_to_prod\"
```

deploy-bot: rollback job started: job-id=rb-1947254321-01, initiated-by=ryan. ETA ~2m for 50% rollout, 6m for global.

sophie (ml-infra): While rollback proceeds, I can start a small warmup job that does targeted GETs for the top 5k prefixes to seed caches in EU/NA. It should reduce miss rate quickly. It will add some load to backend but preferable to p99 breaches.

cheng (oncall): Do it. Also enable temporary bypass-rate-limit so warmup doesn't hit quota. Watch streaming queue depth.

marta (SRE): I'm putting the incident to P2 given customer impact and active rollback. Creating a short mitigation runbook in the incident ticket:
- Rollback prefix-hash -> monitor prefix-hitrate, p95/p99, stream-stall-rate
- Start warmup job for top prefixes
- If rollback fails, route 20% traffic to legacy model variant and enable KV cache TTL override to 2h
- Post-incident: revert config parsing change + add unit tests for prefix->ttl parsing

luis (PM): Noted. I'll notify support and affected account owners with a brief summary and ETA (30m).

deploy-bot: rollback 50% applied (rb-1947254321-01). Monitoring metrics.

marta (SRE): Seeing immediate improvement in EU prefix-hitrate at 50% rollback: 11% -> 64% for sampled keys. p95 dropping to ~340ms. p99 still elevated but trending down.

ryan (eng-runtime): Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollback 100% success (rb-1947254321-01). timestamp=1947254589.

sophie (ml-infra): Warmup job started (warmup-1947254321). Hitting top prefixes in batches of 500, 10s pause between batches.

marta (SRE): p95 at 280ms, p99 980ms — under SLO, streaming stalls down to 0.8%. I'll keep extended watch for 1h.

cheng (oncall): Handoff plan: I'm on until 22:00 UTC. If things look good at 21:30 UTC, I'll hand to night oncall Tim. Leave notes in the ticket about the TTL parsing bug and the config key surface.

ryan (eng-runtime): Root cause preliminary: new prefix-hash change used an incompatible string->hash mapping which changed key namespace; combined with a config parsing edge-case that set TTL to 0 for some computed keys. That produced a cold-start cascade and eviction storm. Will open PR to tighten parsing and add canary watch.

luis (PM): Thanks folks. Action items captured: rollback completed, warmup running, customer comms sent, RCA PR to follow.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2321 updated: status=mitigated, severity=P2, mitigation=rollback+warmup, owner=marta. Follow-up RCA assigned to ryan/sophie.

marta (SRE): Adding final note before handoff: create alert: prefix-hitrate < 60% for 5m -> pageflow-slo-oncall, and add a canary-check in deploy pipeline that validates hit-rate won't drop by >10% in controlled canary.

cheng (oncall): Copy that. Handoff at 21:30 if stable. Closing channel for live triage.

deploy-bot: ticket INC-2321 closed for live triage, transitioned to postmortem queue.
